- Patient with longstanding asthma (well controlled; last exacerbation 3–4 years ago) presents with new 2–3 day history of exertional shortness of breath, wheezing, and cough (non-productive), with poor response to salbutamol inhaler. No hospitalizations or prior use of oral steroids. Family history of atopy (asthma, eczema). Allergic rhinitis/hay fever present.
